title:
Transform for `FetchResult<ReliabilityAssetAlert>` for mapping the {@link ReliabilityAsset} assetImportanceLevel.displayName into the
{@link ReliabilityAsset} assetImportanceLevel.importanceLevel field.
This is done so that the {@link UiSdlDataGrid} component can "natively" support sorting by `assetImportanceLevel.importanceLevel` while displaying just `assetImportanceLevel.displayName`.
name: UiSdlTransformModelAlertsAssetImportanceFetchResult
